duration.pilotPairBoundary: At most two controlled comparison candidates; neither is externally direct-supported for loading reveal.

easing.doNotInherit: Softie 180ms ease as a loading-specific external recommendation

properties.blur: only_if_an_actual_crossfade_double_exposes_and_a_feel_check shows it helps; not a default
properties.implementationTool: plain CSS transition or @starting-style; no new motion library for a simple fade
properties.transformDecision: avoid_for_this_dense_reading_surface as a contextual inference; corpus does not ban transform for all normal loading entrances

reducedMotion.adoptionBoundary: This does not amend DESIGN.md or claim repository-wide reduced-motion adoption.
reducedMotion.alternative: static state or short opacity/color-only dissolve; no transform, stagger, or overshoot

staleRefetchBoundary: No animation while old events remain visible during refetch; only the first empty-state successful fetch is in scope.

vocabulary.use: primary name for loaded content being mounted
safest visual mechanism for a dense list pilot
only if loading and loaded states visibly overlap in the same spot
only when a clip-path or mask actually uncovers content
no scroll trigger in the Today fetch
